title: Terminate Jaym'zz's Contract
description: Terminate Jaym'zz's Contract — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Nielsen

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Go to Je'zzee's Gorage located off of the seventh level of Frump's Misfortune. Find and Kill Je'zzee Jaym'zz and 40 Ice Fade Mechanics. Report to Nielsen in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort when finished.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Nielsen

Repeatable: No

Zone: Frump's Misfortune

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Go to Je'zzee's Gorage located off of the seventh level of Frump's Misfortune. Find and Kill Je'zzee Jaym'zz and 40 Ice Fade Mechanics. Report to Nielsen in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort when finished.

Offer:

Ever since we've hired Je'zzee Jaym'zz, he's been nothing but a hack. Now he doesn't even pretend to be doing any work and is always seen hanging out with a banshee by the name of Sand'ih Boll'ix. Je'zzee had been asking for all these supplies and he keeps saying that you'll 'see his genius' and no matter when you ask the project is 'almost complete'. All this lip service and we've seen nothing. We have come to the conclusion that we have been bamboozled and that Je'zzee Jaym'zz is absolutely worthless. We have someone else lined to take Je'zzee Jaym'zz's timeslot with a show we are thinking of calling Dawg the Dungeon Hunter.

We don't want to see Je'zzee Jaym'zz or their ugly mug around here ever again. Do us the favor of assisting in canceling their contract and tell them Frump style that they're fired.

Once fired, we will need to clear the area of Ice Fade Mechanics to make ready for the new show. Once you have cleared the area of the mechanics and brought the news to Je'zzee, head back to Nielsen in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort and inform him of the good news.

Turn-in:

This season was a total bust, but our marketing research tells us that Dungeon Hunters with Mullets will be the next big rage. We can't wait till the season opener of Dawg The Dungeon Runner to air. Thanks again for helping to clear out all those contracts.

Objectives:

  • Je'zzee Jaym'zz
  • Ice Fade Mechanics

Client level range: 40–45
